summary: Reports say the CIA and the Director of National Intelligence's office found a breach on the same day as the FBI crime-database break-in. FBI Director Patel confirmed the FBI probe but gave no details. No one has named an attacker or linked the cases. Stocks and Bitcoin are also falling on tariff and AI worries.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC to check warrants, stolen cars and missing people. It holds over 18 million records. The FBI has not said what was taken or changed, or if police lost access.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Patel confirmed an active investigation Tuesday but would not say who was behind it. No group has claimed it.

events.title: Reported separate breach of CIA and intelligence office network
events.impact: The network is described as unclassified and used for open-source analysis. Reports say no classified systems were disrupted. Full scope is unknown.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Unnamed sources say it happened the same day as the FBI incident. I only found secondary sites, not an agency statement.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems were shut down. USDA has not said if everything is back. A Tuesday notice said some apps were not yet fully restored or checked.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker is named.

events.title: Tech selloff spreads to Asia; US futures point lower
events.impact: Tuesday close: S&P 500 7,201 (-0.5%), Nasdaq 23,734 (-1.5%). Wednesday: one report has Kospi down 6.1% and Taiex down 4.9%. US futures are down about 1% to 2.8%, depending on the source. No halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI valuation doubts, the Nvidia CEO news and new US tariff worries. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 58-59K USD, down about 9% on the week
events.impact: Price check: Coinbase 58,405 (-2.9% on the day, -9% on the week); CoinGecko 58,718 (-1.4%). About 27% below a month ago. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports point to ETF selling, forced sales and Fed worries.

events.title: More tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran says two more tankers hit mines Wednesday. Monday, three ships were hit by unknown projectiles and kept sailing. Brent is about 90 dollars. One site claims a spike past 120, which price data does not support.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines. The UK maritime office says unidentified projectiles. Iranian claims are not independently verified.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Cloudflare's own status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 09:11 UTC today. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: CISA adds more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Nov 24 additions: Idunno AntiCsrf, Drupal Core and Optimizely Web Experimentation. These are routine notices, not an emergency directive. I saw nothing newer in the feed.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the FBI, CIA or USDA incidents.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI database and CIA network breaches are reported to have happened the same day, but the causes are unknown and no official source links them. The USDA says it shut systems over a cyber threat and named no attacker. Stock and oil moves have stated causes of AI doubts, tariffs and tanker attacks.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the FBI, CIA and USDA incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No official link or attack finding yet, and no widespread public service failure.

prep_note: No action is needed for most people. Keep some cash on hand and a charged phone. Expect possible delays in farm loan and payment services. Do not trade on rumors; check prices on your broker or exchange, and watch FBI and CISA notices for updates.
